item.coloph: 'di srid rgyal phyi sman mo ru sgrub pa'i brgyud pa'o/ thog dang ser ba gtso bor bston (ston) pas/ de'i rgyud nas tsha shubs rin po ches phyung ba'o/ srid rgyal gyi rigs gang la'ang khebs pa'o/ tsha shubs rin po ches 'di bris pas lag shul mkhan dang yon mchod gnyis kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas par shog/
